name: reservation-system
description: This is a full-stack reservation system built with Next.js (Frontend) and Node.js/Express (Backend).

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run server --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix apps/customer" "npm run dev --prefix apps/supplier" "npm run dev --prefix apps/admin"
scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix apps/customer && npm install --prefix apps/supplier && npm install --prefix apps/admin
